description:
Log in to Oscar EMR (oscardoc/oscar/1117) and process a high-priority task (Tickler) for patient Marcus Aurelius. Locate the tickler regarding 'Critical Lab Result: Potassium 6.2'. You must:
1. Open the tickler.
2. Add a comment/note stating: 'Spoke to patient at 09:00. Advised to go to ER immediately. Patient confirmed they are leaving now.'
3. Mark the tickler as 'Complete' (do not delete it).
4. Save the changes.
